record_review: One evening project verifies one named record after its source incident. No supplies, no named hero, no duplicated record counts. Maximum two projects per evening including all other projects.
evidence_timing_contract: Cross-district public copies become accessible after communications recover on day 20. Late verification can restore route eligibility but cannot undo expired promises, settled personal choices or past rescue losses. Early field evidence enables earlier informed interventions; each associated authored scene must implement that timing difference.

endings.shared_control: final selected route=shared_control, mission M24 success, infrastructure sum>=10, >=2 distinct verified evidence IDs
endings.distributed_rebuild: final selected route=distributed_rebuild and M24 success; evidence not required
endings.evacuation: selected evacuation, or the final selected objective fails/partially succeeds. World coda uses preserved district and rescue records.

ending_priority: resolve each hero: withdrawn before personal arc before relationship coda

mission_specific_override.M17: repair成功：泵区+1，上限3；isolate成功：泵区本次不加分且本局上限降为2，当前值超2截为2；两方案互斥。部分/失败按旧表0/-1；旧表笼统成功+1对此关不再适用。最终shared_control按实际各区之和判定。
mission_specific_override.M24: 先选route，再使用boards.M24.route_groups；只激活该路线必需对象，其他路线对象不出现，archive保留。目标没完成则撤离尾声；选择evacuation且失败不是伪造全员成功撤离，按实际saved/lost名单写代价。

record_review_facility_override: 通信台一级新增第18日窗口，二级每项目可核查2份；否则20/22/23日每项目1份。
